feeds.description: A multidisciplinary rapid diagnostic breast center based in Canada. Advocates for dignified access to new technology to prevent, detect and treat breast cancer.

feeds.title: InspireHealth Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to provide the best supportive cancer care possible for people living with a diagnosis of cancer.

feeds.title: Prostate Cancer Centre News
feeds.description: The Prostate Cancer Centre in Calgary supports excellence in prostate cancer awareness, education, treatment, advocacy and research with the ultimate goal of eliminating advanced prostate cancer.

feeds.title: Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario (POGO) Blog
feeds.description: At POGO (Pediatric Oncology Group of Ontario) we give kids with cancer and their families the support they need - not just during the difficult time around therapy, but for years after - when they can face complications from the very treatments that saved their lives.

feeds.title: Colorectal Cancer Canada Blog
feeds.description: Stay informed about colorectal cancer. Read the CCC blog to learn more about colorectal cancer prevention, patient support, research and more. Colorectal Cancer Canada is the nation's not-for-profit colorectal cancer patient organization dedicated to colorectal cancer awareness and education, supporting patients and their caregivers, and advocating on their behalf.

feeds.title: Ontario Institute for Cancer Research News
feeds.description: The latest news, stories, announcements, videos and resources from OICR. The Ontario Institute for Cancer Research (OICR) is a collaborative research institute that conducts and enables high-impact translational cancer research. We help to accelerate the development of discoveries for patients around the world while maximizing the economic benefit of this research for the people of Ontario.

feeds.title: APCaRI Blog
feeds.description: The Alberta Prostate Cancer Research Initiative (APCaRI) brings together a multi-disciplinary team of prostate cancer scientists, physicians, patients, healthcare employees and an international collaborative network together to positively impact the outcomes and quality of life of those living with prostate cancer by accelerating the translation of new research ideas from the laboratory to the clinic.

feeds.title: OWN.CANCER Blog
feeds.description: Right here. Right now. OWN.CANCER with us. One of the largest comprehensive cancer centres in North America is coming to life in Calgary this very second. Concrete walls rising to the big prairie sky will shelter 1.3 million square feet of world-leading cancer care, research and education.

feeds.title: Naturopathic Cancer Blog
feeds.description: Naturopathic Cancer Support. Dr Jeremy has a passion for keeping health simple and is fully devoted to inspiring others to do the same. The meaning of good health comes in many forms. For some, it's about feeling well and having energy to keep up with the kids. For others, it's about being able to get out there to see the world.

feeds.title: Kelowna Skin Cancer Blog
feeds.description: The Okanagan's premier skin health experts. Kelowna Skin Cancer Clinic was established in beautiful Kelowna, BC in 2018. Specializing in skin cancer, our founders are skin health experts who strongly advocate for prevention. We provide in-depth knowledge related to diagnosis, and necessary measures to prevent skin cancer.

feeds.title: PROCURE
feeds.description: PROCURE is a charitable organization in the fight against prostate cancer. It educates, supports, and informs people affected by this disease. It promotes and contributes to the financing of world-class research

feeds.title: Breast Cancer Canada
feeds.description: Features patient success stories, latest cancer events, and research. The Breast Cancer Society of Canada is a national charity dedicated to funding patient-focused breast cancer research.

feeds.title: Canadian Breast Cancer Network (CBCN)
feeds.description: Canada's only patient-directed national breast cancer health charity. We strive to voice the views and concerns of breast cancer patients across the country.

feeds.title: Hillgreen Oncology Acupuncture & Herbs Blog » Cancer
feeds.description: Natural support for people with cancer AND the whole family and the whole family. Hillgreen Oncology Acupuncture & Herbs provides services by licensed health care practitioners, with a special focus on supporting people through cancer treatment and recovery. We offer years of experience with natural healing methods including herbal medicine, nutrition, acupuncture, acupressure, massage, cupping, Qi Gong and mindfulness meditation, and more.

feeds.title: Alberta Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The blog features stories from some of the 53 Albertans and their familes who hear the words 'you have cancer.' every day. Alberta's largest philanthropic investor in cancer research and official fundraising partner for all 17 Alberta Health Services cancer centres.

feeds.title: West Coast Kids Cancer Foundation Blog
feeds.description: West Coast Kids Cancer Foundation is a registered Canadian charity dedicated to creating joy and community for children and families navigating childhood cancer and blood disorders in British Columbia.
